selection.reason: Development tests exposed lean source L1 and nearly adiabatic errors. Reallocate one densely sampled rich composition to phi=0.975 and one intermediate low-flow row to r=0.55, retaining 432 physical flames. Previously reserved tests become development; require fresh confirmation. Weak-loss confirmation also identified heat-flux errors between r=0.9 and 0.95; reallocate two dense low-flow rows to r=0.85 and 0.925.

limitations: Steady planar burner library; no conjugate solid heat transfer, radiation or transient wall quenching.
